Name: DE-Transitions
Description: Extracts the list of existing transitions.
Statement:
with 
mot as 
(
    select  WorkflowStateTransition,
            string_agg(cast(Description as nvarchar(max)), ', ') as Motives
    from    WorkflowStateTransitionMotive
    group by WorkflowStateTransition
),
act as
(
    select  wsa.WorkflowStateTransition,
            string_agg(cast(dat.Name as nvarchar(max)), ', ') as Actions
    from    WorkflowStateTransitionAction wsa
                join DocumentActionType dat on dat.Oid = wsa.DocumentActionType
    group by wsa.WorkflowStateTransition
),
pro as
(
    select  wat.WorkflowState,
            string_agg(cast(ast.Name as nvarchar(max)), ', ') as Teams
    from    WorkflowStateAssignmentType wat
                join AssignmentType ast on ast.Oid = wat.AssignmentType
    where   wat.AllowWrite = 1
    group by wat.WorkflowState
),
rol as 
(
    select  wtr.WorkflowStateTransition,
            string_agg(cast(rol.Name as nvarchar(max)), ', ') as Roles
    from    WorkflowStateTransitionRole wtr
                join RoleLookup rol on rol.Id = wtr.Role
    group by wtr.WorkflowStateTransition
),
typ as
(
    select  WorkflowId,
            string_agg(cast(TypeId as nvarchar(max)), ', ') as TypeIds,
            string_agg(cast(Type as nvarchar(max)), ', ') as Types
    from    (
                select  distinct 
                        Workflow as WorkflowId,
                        Oid as TypeId,
                        Name as Type
                from    JobType
            ) t
    group by WorkflowId
)
select  wt.Oid,
        wt.Oid as TransitionId,
        wt.Name as Transition,
        doc.Name as Document,
        doc.Oid as DocumentId,
        dty.Name as Workflow,
        dty.Oid as WorkflowId,
        fws.Name as FromWorkflowState,
        fws.Oid as FromWorkflowStateId,
        tws.Name as ToWorkflowState,
        tws.Oid as ToWorkflowStateId,
        wt.ExternalId,
        wt.[Order],
        wt.RequestConfirmation,
        wt.MustSendNotification,
        wt.CommentRequired,
        wt.HoursRequired,
        wt.FileUploadRequired,
        wt.FileUploadFolder,
        wt.QueryValidation,
        mot.Motives,
        act.Actions,
        fpr.Teams as FromAllowWriteTeams,
        tpr.Teams as ToAllowWriteTeams,
        rol.Roles,
        typ.TypeIds,
        typ.Types
from    WorkflowStateTransition as wt
	        left join WorkflowState fws on fws.Oid = wt.FromWorkflowState
		    left join WorkflowState tws on tws.Oid = wt.ToWorkflowState
            join Document as doc on wt.Document = doc.Oid
            join DocumentType as dty on wt.DocumentType = dty.Oid
            left join typ on typ.WorkflowId = dty.Oid
            left join mot on mot.WorkflowStateTransition = wt.Oid
            left join act on act.WorkflowStateTransition = wt.Oid
            left join pro fpr on fpr.WorkflowState = fws.Oid
            left join pro tpr on tpr.WorkflowState = tws.Oid
            left join rol on rol.WorkflowStateTransition = wt.Oid
